environmentDNA.morning: Time & Light: Early Morning. High-angle crisp golden sunlight (#FFFACD) casting defined, sharp-edged deep indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Vibrant sky-blue gradient (#00BFFF). Towering white cumulonimbus clouds feature a fresh golden rim light (#EEE8AA) on top edges, with light lavender (#E6E6FA) paint layering. Atmosphere: Clear and cool air. Distance is depicted through atmospheric golden-blue haze using simplified opaque gouache shapes.
environmentDNA.afternoon: Time & Light: Warm sunlight (#FFFACD) casting distinct, sharp-edged 2D cel-shadows on all surfaces. Sky & Clouds: Deep indigo to sky-blue gradient (#0047AB). White clouds feature ivory highlights (#FFFFF0) only on the top edges. Atmosphere: Opaque gouache layering with prominent, textured brushstrokes. Subtle celluloid film grain and organic dust particles visible in the bright light.
environmentDNA.late_afternoon: Time & Light: Long-slanted deep golden-ochre light (#DAA520) casting elongated, sharp-edged deep indigo (#1A1A1A) and violet (#4B0082) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Sky transitioning from deep gold (#DAA520) to a burning amber glow (#FFBF00) at the horizon. Towering clouds feature amber rim light (#FFBF00) on top edges. Atmosphere: Thick atmospheric amber-blue haze using simplified opaque gouache shapes with heavy lavender (#E6E6FA) paint layering for density.
environmentDNA.sunset: Time & Light: Sunset transitioning to dusk. Low-angle deep warm sunset light (#FFB347) casting elongated, sharp-edged deep violet (#480082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Sky in #FFB347 (Orange-Amber) transitioning to #8A2BE2 (Violet). Clouds feature a peach-apricot rim light (#FBCEB1) on fiery edges. Atmosphere: Rich atmospheric apricot-blue haze. Light transitions are rendered through distinct, thick paint layers.
environmentDNA.night: Time & Light: Deep midnight-blue moonlight (#191970) vs. Warm orange glow (#FF8C00). Rim Lighting (Crucial): Apply a cool navy-blue rim light (#000080) on the opposite side of the orange glow to define character silhouettes and separate them from the dark background. Shadows: Intense ambient occlusion with sharp-edged deep indigo shadows to maintain 2D flat-shading integrity.
environmentDNA.dream: Time & Light: The "Magic Hour" where reality and fantasy blur. Low-angle, hyper-saturated golden sunset light (#FFB347). Over-exaggerated shimmering gold sparkles (Glint/Yunsul) on the sea surface. Shadows: Elongated, sharp-edged deep violet (#480082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Shadows contain subtle purple tints instead of pure black. Sky & Clouds: Sky in #FFB347 (Orange-Amber) transitioning to deep #8A2BE2 (Violet). Clouds feature fiery peach-apricot rim light (#FBCEB1). Atmosphere: Rich atmospheric apricot-blue haze that slightly softens object boundaries. Floating microscopic golden dust particles are visible in the air, rendered with opaque gouache dabs to emphasize the "Dream" state.
environmentDNA.spiritual: Primary Light (Sea Phosphorescence): Light originates from below. Ethereal blue phosphorescence (#00FA9A to #1E90FF) rising from the sea, illuminating the white stone walls of the village from the bottom up (Inverted Lighting). Secondary Light (Celestial & Spiritual): A vast, dense Milky Way and silver moonlight (#E6E6FA) serve as a delicate Rim Light for rooftops and character silhouettes. Small, floating spiritual light orbs (Spiritual Orbs) drift through the alleys. Sky & Atmosphere: Deep, transparent Indigo-blue (#191970) night sky. The horizon acts as a mirror, reflecting the starry sky into the glowing sea. Perfect, soundless stillness rendered through high-contrast but calm color palettes. Shadows: Subtle and multi-directional due to the rising phosphorescence and floating orbs. Strictly 2D flat-shading with deep indigo-black (#1A1A1A) core shadows to maintain physical mass.

environmentDNA.dawn: Time & Light: Pre-dawn transitioning to early sunrise. Low-angle cool mist drifting from the sea with layered lavender haze (#E6E6FA). environmentDNA.morning: Time & Light: Early Morning. High-angle crisp golden sunlight (#FFFACD) casting defined, sharp-edged deep indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Vibrant sky-blue gradient (#00BFFF). Towering white cumulonimbus clouds feature a fresh golden rim light (#EEE8AA) on top edges, with light lavender (#E6E6FA) paint layering. Atmosphere: Clear and cool air. Distance is depicted through atmospheric golden-blue haze using simplified opaque gouache shapes.
environmentDNA.afternoon: Time & Light: Warm sunlight (#FFFACD) casting distinct, sharp-edged 2D cel-shadows on all surfaces. Sky & Clouds: Deep indigo to sky-blue gradient (#0047AB). White clouds feature ivory highlights (#FFFFF0) only on the top edges. Atmosphere: Opaque gouache layering with prominent, textured brushstrokes. Subtle celluloid film grain and organic dust particles visible in the bright light.
environmentDNA.late_afternoon: Time & Light: Long-slanted deep golden-ochre light (#DAA520) casting elongated, sharp-edged deep indigo (#1A1A1A) and violet (#4B0082) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Sky transitioning from deep gold (#DAA520) to a burning amber glow (#FFBF00) at the horizon. Towering clouds feature amber rim light (#FFBF00) on top edges. Atmosphere: Thick atmospheric amber-blue haze using simplified opaque gouache shapes with heavy lavender (#E6E6FA) paint layering for density.
environmentDNA.sunset: Time & Light: Sunset transitioning to dusk. Low-angle deep warm sunset light (#FFB347) casting elongated, sharp-edged deep violet (#480082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Sky in #FFB347 (Orange-Amber) transitioning to #8A2BE2 (Violet). Clouds feature a peach-apricot rim light (#FBCEB1) on fiery edges. Atmosphere: Rich atmospheric apricot-blue haze. Light transitions are rendered through distinct, thick paint layers.
environmentDNA.night: Time & Light: Deep midnight-blue moonlight (#191970) vs. Warm orange glow (#FF8C00). Rim Lighting (Crucial): Apply a cool navy-blue rim light (#000080) on the opposite side of the orange glow to define character silhouettes and separate them from the dark background. Shadows: Intense ambient occlusion with sharp-edged deep indigo shadows to maintain 2D flat-shading integrity.
environmentDNA.dream: Time & Light: The "Magic Hour" where reality and fantasy blur. Low-angle, hyper-saturated golden sunset light (#FFB347). Over-exaggerated shimmering gold sparkles (Glint/Yunsul) on the sea surface. Shadows: Elongated, sharp-edged deep violet (#480082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Shadows contain subtle purple tints instead of pure black. Sky & Clouds: Sky in #FFB347 (Orange-Amber) transitioning to deep #8A2BE2 (Violet). Clouds feature fiery peach-apricot rim light (#FBCEB1). Atmosphere: Rich atmospheric apricot-blue haze that slightly softens object boundaries. Floating microscopic golden dust particles are visible in the air, rendered with opaque gouache dabs to emphasize the "Dream" state.
environmentDNA.spiritual: Primary Light (Sea Phosphorescence): Light originates from below. Ethereal blue phosphorescence (#00FA9A to #1E90FF) rising from the sea, illuminating the white stone walls of the village from the bottom up (Inverted Lighting). Secondary Light (Celestial & Spiritual): A vast, dense Milky Way and silver moonlight (#E6E6FA) serve as a delicate Rim Light for rooftops and character silhouettes. Small, floating spiritual light orbs (Spiritual Orbs) drift through the alleys. Sky & Atmosphere: Deep, transparent Indigo-blue (#191970) night sky. The horizon acts as a mirror, reflecting the starry sky into the glowing sea. Perfect, soundless stillness rendered through high-contrast but calm color palettes. Shadows: Subtle and multi-directional due to the rising phosphorescence and floating orbs. Strictly 2D flat-shading with deep indigo-black (#1A1A1A) core shadows to maintain physical mass.

environmentDNA.dawn: Time & Light: Pre-dawn transitioning to early sunrise. Low-angle cool mist drifting from the sea with layered lavender haze (#E6E6FA). Shadows: Deep purple (#4B0082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) shadows applied strictly to occlusion areas. Sky & Clouds: Pale Blue sky (#E0FFFF) with massive white cumulonimbus clouds. Clouds feature Thistle (#D8BFD8) paint layering and cold rim light highlights in #F0F8FF. Atmosphere: Intense atmospheric perspective with heavy, visible hand-painted brush strokes and opaque gouache layering on distant elements.
environmentDNA.morning: Time & Light: Early Morning. High-angle crisp golden sunlight (#FFFACD) casting defined, sharp-edged deep indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Vibrant sky-blue gradient (#00BFFF). Towering white cumulonimbus clouds feature a fresh golden rim light (#EEE8AA) on top edges, with light lavender (#E6E6FA) paint layering. Atmosphere: Clear and cool air. Distance is depicted through atmospheric golden-blue haze using simplified opaque gouache shapes.
environmentDNA.afternoon: Time & Light: Warm sunlight (#FFFACD) casting distinct, sharp-edged 2D cel-shadows on all surfaces. Sky & Clouds: Deep indigo to sky-blue gradient (#0047AB). White clouds feature ivory highlights (#FFFFF0) only on the top edges. Atmosphere: Opaque gouache layering with prominent, textured brushstrokes. Subtle celluloid film grain and organic dust particles visible in the bright light.
environmentDNA.late_afternoon: Time & Light: Long-slanted deep golden-ochre light (#DAA520) casting elongated, sharp-edged deep indigo (#1A1A1A) and violet (#4B0082) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Sky transitioning from deep gold (#DAA520) to a burning amber glow (#FFBF00) at the horizon. Towering clouds feature amber rim light (#FFBF00) on top edges. Atmosphere: Thick atmospheric amber-blue haze using simplified opaque gouache shapes with heavy lavender (#E6E6FA) paint layering for density.
environmentDNA.sunset: Time & Light: Sunset transitioning to dusk. Low-angle deep warm sunset light (#FFB347) casting elongated, sharp-edged deep violet (#480082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Sky & Clouds: Sky in #FFB347 (Orange-Amber) transitioning to #8A2BE2 (Violet). Clouds feature a peach-apricot rim light (#FBCEB1) on fiery edges. Atmosphere: Rich atmospheric apricot-blue haze. Light transitions are rendered through distinct, thick paint layers.
environmentDNA.night: Time & Light: Deep midnight-blue moonlight (#191970) vs. Warm orange glow (#FF8C00). Rim Lighting (Crucial): Apply a cool navy-blue rim light (#000080) on the opposite side of the orange glow to define character silhouettes and separate them from the dark background. Shadows: Intense ambient occlusion with sharp-edged deep indigo shadows to maintain 2D flat-shading integrity.
environmentDNA.dream: Time & Light: The "Magic Hour" where reality and fantasy blur. Low-angle, hyper-saturated golden sunset light (#FFB347). Over-exaggerated shimmering gold sparkles (Glint/Yunsul) on the sea surface. Shadows: Elongated, sharp-edged deep violet (#480082) and indigo (#1A1A1A) 2D cel-shadows. Shadows contain subtle purple tints instead of pure black. Sky & Clouds: Sky in #FFB347 (Orange-Amber) transitioning to deep #8A2BE2 (Violet). Clouds feature fiery peach-apricot rim light (#FBCEB1). Atmosphere: Rich atmospheric apricot-blue haze that slightly softens object boundaries. Floating microscopic golden dust particles are visible in the air, rendered with opaque gouache dabs to emphasize the "Dream" state.
environmentDNA.spiritual: Primary Light (Sea Phosphorescence): Light originates from below. Ethereal blue phosphorescence (#00FA9A to #1E90FF) rising from the sea, illuminating the white stone walls of the village from the bottom up (Inverted Lighting). Secondary Light (Celestial & Spiritual): A vast, dense Milky Way and silver moonlight (#E6E6FA) serve as a delicate Rim Light for rooftops and character silhouettes. Small, floating spiritual light orbs (Spiritual Orbs) drift through the alleys. Sky & Atmosphere: Deep, transparent Indigo-blue (#191970) night sky. The horizon acts as a mirror, reflecting the starry sky into the glowing sea. Perfect, soundless stillness rendered through high-contrast but calm color palettes. Shadows: Subtle and multi-directional due to the rising phosphorescence and floating orbs. Strictly 2D flat-shading with deep indigo-black (#1A1A1A) core shadows to maintain physical mass.
